meta.name: security-audit
meta.description: Deep security audit covering OWASP Top 10, authentication, authorization, data protection, dependency vulnerabilities, and secrets scanning. Delegates to the Centinela (QA) agent.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描代码中的安全漏洞与配置风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在发布前发现并修复安全漏洞。
copy.tagline_en: Scan code for security vulnerabilities and configuration risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find and fix security vulnerabilities before release.

howto.what: 执行深度安全审计，覆盖OWASP Top 10、认证、授权、数据保护、依赖漏洞和密钥扫描。会运行检查清单，扫描硬编码密钥和依赖漏洞，检查智能合约，最后给出结论并生成报告文件。
howto.when: 当用户要求进行安全审计，或输入/security-audit命令时；典型场景是发布前、重要代码变更后、添加新依赖时。

say.text: 对src/auth/目录做一次安全审计。
say.note: Claude会针对该目录生成审计报告。

say.text: 扫描代码里的硬编码密钥和依赖漏洞。
say.note: 会运行密钥扫描和依赖审计。

say.text: 运行完整安全审计，给出结论和修复建议。

howto.what_en: Performs a deep security audit covering OWASP Top 10, authentication, authorization, data protection, dependency vulnerabilities, and secrets scanning. It runs checklists, scans for hardcoded secrets and dependency CVEs, checks smart contracts, issues a verdict, and writes a report.
howto.when_en: When the user requests a security audit or uses /security-audit, typically before releases, after significant code changes, or when adding dependencies.

say_en.text: Run a security audit on src/auth/.
say_en.note: Generates an audit report for that directory.

say_en.text: Scan code for hardcoded secrets and dependency vulnerabilities.
say_en.note: Runs secret scanning and dependency audit.

say_en.text: Perform a full security audit and give a verdict with fix suggestions.
